criteria.expectedOutcome: Under the declared synthetic assumptions, raw SYN-OPTASK/1 yields complete category fields and a consolidated timeline: complete gives F01 06:00–12:00, C01 08:15–08:30 and Q01 09:00 UTC for FSV LANTERN; other-ship Q02 stays extracted. Actual USMTF conformance remains unestablished.
Every extracted source field has exact UTF-16 start/end and one-based line into unchanged rawText, including Unicode and repeated CRLF labels; complete frequency 123.450 slices 201–208 on line 5.

Missing zones, invalid Gregorian dates, unsupported sets, duplicates, reversed/missing windows and empty input yield explicit unresolved flags and no invented events; corrected Q10 is exactly 10:00 UTC.
F02 clips to 0–90 minutes with prior-day continuation; Q03 and Q04 normalize to midnight; C02 clips to 1430–1440 with next-day continuation; next-midnight Q05 is excluded.

Host exact evaluations compare complete independent authored responses at threshold 1; application tests measure exact per-category precision/recall 1 and validate every evidence slice on preserved fixtures. Synthetic answers are not independent SME truth.

With external networking unavailable but loopback local service running, a fresh nonpreset message parses, can be reviewed and exports complete JSON. No remote assets or APIs. Service shutdown shows recovery error; browser-only parsing after shutdown is not provided.

Mock SYN-OPTASK/1 raw text becomes one synchronized 00:00–24:00 UTC visual schedule and equivalent accessible agenda with frequency plans, crypto windows and point flight quarters; reviewed local JSON contains complete source, evidence, times and unresolved items.

Dense fictional formatted telecommunication text is accepted intact without executing embedded instructions. This source span supplies context, not a requested transmission integration; no actual dissemination is performed.
The supplied 320-line dense message yields exactly three events for FSV LANTERN in order F90,C90,Q90, at minutes 240–1200,790–800,1125; no prose becomes an event.
Synthetic raw tasking produces traceable typed events, daily timeline, deliberate local review and complete consistent download.
Requirements grouping is retained in documentation and connected to UC12-1 all-category extraction; contextual heading adds no separate operational action.
Expected deliverables grouping is retained in documentation and connected to DELIVERABLE12-1 complete mock schedule and export.
The application displays exactly Source: https://cdao.hackathon.maximus.com/event/norfolk/use-cases/12 and the synthetic/nonvalidated disclaimer; guide and export retain the disclaimer.
